name: Club Rec Summer Program
description_short: City run summer day program at Spence Farm in Woburn with gym and outdoor games, crafts, pool swimming and field trips on Tuesdays and Thursdays. Runs Monday to Thursday 9 to 3 and Fridays 9 to 1, with a free bagged lunch offered.
refund_policy_summary: Withdrawals must be in writing. Full refund by May 1, 75% by May 15, 50% by May 29, 25% by June 5. Medical or family emergencies with documentation get a full refund less $10 if made a week ahead.
special_needs_notes: Families should talk with the Recreation Director or Assistant Director before the program starts about any accommodations; school 504 and IEP plans do not carry over. Children must be fully toilet trained.
swim_waterfront_notes: Children are swim tested at their first swim block; those who do not pass stay in the shallow end or wear a Coast Guard approved life jacket supplied by the family. Lifeguards supervise at all times.

sources.note: Researched by Claude from this page. 2026 Club Rec parent handbook. Drop off and pick up at Spence Farm, 41 Wyman St. Early drop off from 8:00am for an added fee. Free bagged lunch through Project Bread; families may pack their own. Phone is the Club Rec staff cell.

Researched by Claude from this page. 2026 summer brochure, Club Rec page: seven weeks for ages 6 to 8 and 9 to 12 at $275 per week, limited to 3 weeks per child; early drop off $40 per week. One rate shown, no separate non-resident rate. Financial assistance on request. The brochure numbers the weeks but the text gives no dates for them.

source.title: Woburn Recreation Club Rec Summer Program Parent Handbook 2026
